carried_minor_issues: [minor] Under '남은 빈칸' result.md says estimate's stale check covers only the media snapshot, so a change to plan context alone could leave an action marked valid [추정]. That is wrong, and it overstates the gap. media_snapshot is snapshot(project) with only the chat selection removed. snapshot includes guided.context(p) (music, snapshot, ontology), which is the input to plan['context_hash'], and includes the revision of every shot. Any plan-context or shot-revision change therefore already marks the action stale.

[minor] The fix to test_chat_preflight builds its expected body from self.runtime.limits()['tools'], which comes from the code under test. If the legacy default regressed and re-added request_media_generation, preflight would still pass. Only the pin test in test_general_chat_tool_invariants would catch it. The expectation is self-referential, although the byte-boundary assertions are kept.

[minor] Cross-track citation drift. Inserting LEGACY_DEFAULT_TOOLS shifted chat_runtime.py down 3 lines. The D1-frame-observation-design-r2 result (written 17:43, after the r2 edit at 17:38) cites chat_runtime.py:175 and :331-332 using the old numbering. The cited content is now at :178 and :333-334.

[minor] The shortened descriptions dropped clauses that disambiguate before a call, such as 'Scoped snapshot, not semantic search.' and 'Catalog only; not proof of a live connection.'. The justification is that result fields (search_mode/note, live_execution=False) carry the same information, but the model only sees those after it has chosen and called the tool. The defect brief asked for exactly this kind of trim, so this complies. The effect on model behavior was not measured, and the worker marks this as an assumption.
